purpose: Synthetic fitting-engine integrity checks, not biological model evaluation
fixture_settings_context: Fixed synthetic fixture and small engineering-fit settings; integrity controls were refined during implementation. No biological result was used.
fixture: For i=0..31, b_j=(i>>j)&1; X=[b0,b1,b0^b1,b2,b3,b4], y=b0&b1&b2. Metadata uses four synthetic hosts (i%4) and eight synthetic phages (i//4), with consistent feature vectors per genome. No real genomes or phenotype sources.
checks: Actual CatBoost/RFE fit, frozen bundle save/load and finite nonconstant scores
Renaming synthetic row/host/phage identifiers bijectively leaves scores unchanged at fixed tolerance
Host-only fitting and scoring are invariant to all phage-column perturbations
Relatedness-group leakage is rejected even when IDs differ; unsupported split regimes do not fall back to random rows
Reordered feature schema and modified manifest/model/spec/selection artifacts are rejected against manifest hashes frozen before scoring
